items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I met my next wife, who is my present wife, Joanne Roberts... married Joanne Roberts Gidney in 1963.

ctx.x: Yes, he was born in 1946. And, let's see, I think the marriage broke up about 1955 or '56. Got divorced and I got remarried, let's see, I married a young lady who was working for the London House in those days, doing promotions, record promotions for London House. Her name was Blanche Loft. She's originally from Massachusetts, around the Adams-Pittsfield area, she was working for London House, and we got married. And we had a son born in 1958. I guess we got married in 1957, and my son Steven, S-t-e-v-e-n, he was…

And then, unfortunately, that marriage finished, and then I met my next wife, who is my present wife, Joanne Roberts, her maiden name was. By that time she was Joanne Gidney from Cleveland, Ohio. She'd previously been married to an excellent pianist in Cleveland, Bill Gidney. And let's see, after about three years I was separated from Blanche, Bunny, we call her, Blanche Flower, in 1960, and then married Joanne Roberts Gidney in 1963. And we have two children of

that marriage, a little girl, Dune, who's now 13 years old, D-u-n-e, and a brother James, who's 14 now. And he's named after my father, and my older brother, were both James. And also Joanne's son by her previous marriage with Bill Gidney is with us now and his name's William, we call him Bill. And Bill is now my adopted son. So his name is not Bill Gidney, it's Bill Wilson now. And let's see, Bill's a senior at Ohio State right now, and graduating this year, 1980. And Steven is enrolled in the Berkeley College…
